quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: before the raised funds arrived it invested its own funds in capacity construction, and the new capacity has been coming into use; the new plant was put into use as planned; it laid out A5-series product lines in advance, and some 224G high-speed connectors have been delivered in volume per customer demand, with capacity expansion and ramp continuing in Q3 and Q4 against customer orders. Production and delivery have improved markedly since July, demand is strong, orders on hand are ample and capacity utilization stays high. It is pre-researching 448Gbps products and filing related patents. Overseas business, one of its four strategic paths, is at the strategic-layout and start-up stage. It has invested in Huizhou Aohua Intelligent Technology, an automotive-connector company, to round out its vehicle-connector business.
